description: Shank pave retained by SHARED micro prongs: one prong per shared lattice corner, each serving every stone that touches it. Locks in the fourth retention strategy and that the shared-corner topology genuinely produces fewer prongs than an individual field would.
knownLimitations: EXTENDED_SETTING_MODES_AWAITING_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW: every dimension in this design is a software construction parameter. No minimum wall, minimum bar, collar thickness, clearance or settability judgment is asserted anywhere, because no sourced professional evidence for one exists in this project. The baseline is a software regression guard.
REFERENCE_RELIEF_IS_NOT_A_CUT_SEAT: the recess is the stone's own volume removed from the metal. It has no bearing shoulder, and no claim is made that a stone would sit correctly in it.
notes: Sprint 27 Extended Setting Modes v1: INITIAL_BASELINE for a newly executable setting mode. Created by running the real pipeline; no existing baseline was modified.
